'''Jorthal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]] who lived on the war-torn [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He made a living as a vendor by selling light armor to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] citizens.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jorthal appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Light Armor Vendor for Imperial players on Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> he was removed from the game along with the rest of the Light Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
